Warehouse Keeper Valkon:
Good! You are a good fellow. Now listen to me carefully. I have heard of a very precious crystal, what was its name, yes, that's right, it is called the Purifying Crystal. Only one person alive can make it: Maria, in the Town of Dion. Her family has kept the secret of the crystals for generations, so there is no one else to ask. I have marked her place on your map.
If you will bring me one of those, I shall gladly give you that Scriptures of Knowledge.
